name: Dual-Axis Joystick Module
fullName: KY-023 Dual-Axis PS2 Thumb Joystick Module with Push Button
tagline: Analog 2-axis (X/Y) thumb controller with momentary integrated tactile push button
description: The Dual-Axis Joystick module contains two 10kΩ potentiometers placed perpendicularly (one for X-axis, one for Y-axis) and a central momentary push button. Moving the stick outputs continuous analog voltages (0V to 5V) centered at 2.5V.

specs.potentiometers: Dual 10kΩ linear potentiometers (X and Y axes)
specs.pushSwitch: Tactile switch triggered by pressing the stick straight down (Z-axis)
specs.outputs: Analog X, Analog Y, Digital Switch (SW)

pinout.name: X-Axis
pinout.desc: Analog output voltage for horizontal axis (0–1023)

pinout.name: Y-Axis
pinout.desc: Analog output voltage for vertical axis (0–1023)

wiringNote: Use internal pull-up on the Arduino pin connected to SW (`pinMode(swPin, INPUT_PULLUP)`).
commonMistakes: Expecting exact 512 center reading without software deadband calibration (natural joystick resting center varies ~490–530)
Forgetting pull-up resistor on the SW switch pin
